t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tallerr brown knome brings more mushrooms. Don't let your mind wonder.

vb_textbox.text: Answer as quickly as possible to avoid losing any points.I found the pink and brown knomes to yield the best results most of the time.The red and purple pairing of knomes seem to give the biggest bonus but I found the 'correct' knome for this pairing would change regularly.
